review: New target route reuses the existing fixed-stage reader and source-bound shared window. Calculator and legacy target pages retain independent source contexts. Only one exact enemy id/level match is preselected; otherwise the stage overview opens. Cached same-source pages retain reading, while changed target or calculation scope invalidates the old reference chain. The new header returns to the unchanged original calculator. First unique-enemy opening gets a readable height and a single native deferred scroll, cached reopen does not scroll again. The existing mechanism_copy dictionary shortens exact presentation sentences only. Enemy details_toggle reveals the unchanged full model report and all qualifications; images, numeric calculations and source data remain intact. No new retries, catch blocks, provider calls or game controls.
